step.label: Analyze product cost and complexity impact
step.description: Evaluate newly proposed materials and product designs against cost and complexity benchmarks to identify optimization opportunities.
step.useCase: Product managers need to understand cost implications of design decisions before advancing to procurement.

step.label: Retrieve qualified materials and vendor catalogs
step.description: Access the approved material and vendor qualification database to identify pre-vetted procurement sources.
step.useCase: Procurement teams need rapid access to qualified materials and vendors to meet sourcing timelines.

step.label: Orchestrate material and vendor qualification workflow
step.description: Coordinate multi-step vendor evaluation and material certification processes to ensure compliance and quality standards.
step.useCase: Supply chain managers need automated workflows to manage complex material qualification across multiple vendors and standards.

step.label: Validate bill of materials cost and compliance
step.description: Audit the complete bill of materials against cost thresholds, regulatory requirements, and material compliance standards.
step.useCase: Engineering and compliance teams must verify that BOMs meet both cost targets and regulatory obligations before purchase orders are issued.

step.label: Process engineering change requests and product updates
step.description: Manage and route engineering change notices through approval workflows and update affected product configurations.
step.useCase: Engineering change coordinators need to track and implement design modifications without disrupting production schedules.

step.label: Create and approve purchase orders with vendor contracts
step.description: Generate and transmit purchase orders to qualified vendors with negotiated terms, pricing, and delivery schedules.
step.useCase: Procurement specialists must issue purchase orders to vendors while maintaining audit trails and contract compliance.

step.label: Monitor incident and safety compliance during fulfillment
step.description: Track supplier performance incidents and safety metrics to ensure vendor compliance and early issue resolution.
step.useCase: Supply chain quality teams need real-time visibility into vendor performance issues to prevent delivery failures and safety risks.

step.label: Dashboard incident resolution and compliance performance
step.description: Report on safety incident resolution times and vendor compliance performance to identify systemic procurement quality trends.
step.useCase: Procurement leadership needs consolidated visibility into vendor safety and compliance metrics to drive continuous improvement.
